name: cetylpyridinium + glycerin
purpose: Purpose: Glycerin – Temporarily relieves dry mouth -Cetylpyridinium Chloride – Helps reduce germs that cause bad breath and plaque OTC- Purpose
uses: Usage: For temporary relief of dry mouth Helps kill germs that cause bad breath Helps reduce plaque that leads to early gum problems Freshens breath Indications & Usage
otcwarn: Warnings: For oral use only.Do not swallow. Not for children under 6 years of age Stop use and ask a doctor if irritation or discomfort occurs. Keep out of reach of children Warnings
